segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Today I want us aligned on one Q4 launch story, the milestone sequence, and ownership.

segments.speaker: Lina
segments.text: Marketing’s current draft focuses on AI features, but the stronger story is time saved after meetings.

segments.speaker: Bilal
segments.text: Sales is hearing the same thing. Buyers care less about feature count and more about whether teams move faster.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Then let’s make measurable time saved from meetings the core narrative.

segments.speaker: Lina
segments.text: I’ll update the campaign language around that.

segments.speaker: Bilal
segments.text: For partner outreach, I need a short proof deck and a list of reference customers before I start.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Marketing owns campaign assets. Sales owns partner outreach.

segments.speaker: Lina
segments.text: I’ll have the final campaign narrative ready by Tuesday noon.

segments.speaker: Bilal
segments.text: I’ll prepare the partner outreach list by Wednesday noon.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: We also need customer proof before the public launch.

segments.speaker: Lina
segments.text: I can turn the strongest customer quotes into two short proof points.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Let’s require at least two customer proof points before public launch.

segments.speaker: Lina
segments.text: Campaign assets should be finalized before partner outreach starts.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Then we have the narrative, the owners, and the milestone order locked.
